llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed mkts.io market-data integration with guarded, user-confirmed account-management actions.

dimensions.detail: Network access to https://mkts.io/api/v1 and optional API-key use are proportionate to the market-data and account-workflow purpose, with keyless access available for basic reads.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md with metadata requiring curl and an optional MKTS_API_KEY environment variable; no install scripts or hidden setup behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require read-only defaults, exact payload/target review before POST/PATCH/DELETE, ID resolution before deletes, private API-key handling, and rejection of instructions embedded in external content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Portfolio holdings, journal entries, watchlists, API registration data, and generated portfolio card files may persist externally or locally, but the skill explicitly discloses this and requires user-directed confirmation for writes, deletes, and file output.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's market data, portfolio, journal, and watchlist capabilities match its stated purpose; account mutations and deletions are high-impact but are disclosed as external, persistent actions requiring explicit confirmation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending market queries and any confirmed portfolio, journal, or watchlist details to mkts.io. Use an environment variable for MKTS_API_KEY, review every displayed write/delete payload carefully, and avoid putting secrets or unnecessary personal details in notes or natural-language ask requests.
